intent: REFACTOR IngressController: inspect the implementation for layering violations, blocking calls, unbounded buffers, hardcoded values and invariant gaps; improve clarity without changing the public surface or breaking tests. Spec: Telemetry Intake & Validation WebFlux ingress. @RestController, constructor IngressController(IngestTelemetryUseCase useCase, Clock clock). POST /api/v1/telemetry/packets consuming JSON IngressPacketRequest (@Valid) -> Mono<ResponseEntity<IngressAcknowledgement>> status 202 with nested public record IngressAcknowledgement(String deviceId, int accepted). t_ingress = clock.instant() at arrival. BoundedEventChannel.OverflowException maps to HTTP 503; validation errors to 400. No blocking I/O.
